scale.$description: Scale of a solid control while pressed (SJButton). Not applied under prefers-reduced-motion.

delay.$description: SJSkeleton: how long a load must last before its placeholder becomes visible. A load that ends sooner never flashes a skeleton (NN/g response-time limits).

min-duration.$description: SJSkeleton: once visible, the placeholder stays at least this long, so content that arrives just after the delay does not flash it in and out.

shimmer.$description: SJSkeleton: one pass of the shimmer sweep. Slow and subtle; static under prefers-reduced-motion and forced colors.
